releaseNotes:
🎬 OpenTV v2.5.0 (Build 52) - Cinematic 4-Column UI & Complete Remote Dock Navigation:
• Maximum 4 Items Per Row: Live TV, Movies, Series, and Search shelves locked to a spacious, cinematic 4 items per row layout with larger posters and logos
• 10-Foot TV Readability: Scaled top bar tabs, screen title, clock, channel names, and movie titles for comfortable viewing from 10 feet away
• Restored Free Public Tab: Seamless bidirectional remote D-Pad navigation to and from the Free Web tab
• Global Scrollbar Purge: Completely eliminated all vertical and horizontal scrollbars on the bottom and right
• Movie Player D-Pad Dock Navigation: Down arrow and Left/Right now smoothly scroll between player buttons (Rewind, Play/Pause, Forward, 🚀 External Player/VLC, Restart, Info) with intense focus glow
• One-Click VLC Handoff: Switch from the built-in player to VLC / MX Player right from the remote control during playback or while paused
